category_note: Hand-built product UI from repo source (no URL capture). Same window chrome, pointer, and envelope as mcp-approval.
style: data-peek motion kit: dark devtool, monospace-native, quiet confidence. One cropped data-peek window on an Ask tab, no kit topbar so the answer block has room.
font: Geist Variable + Geist Mono Variable (local woff2)

reused_techniques.oversized-cursor: macOS arrow path from mcp-approval, tip-anchored transform origin, glide then press
reused_techniques.per-glyph-typing: composer text split into glyph spans; tl.set reveals each glyph and moves the caret to its measured right edge
reused_techniques.clip-reveal: SQL lines and the answer card open with clip-path inset so empty layout never shows

layout.window: x 100 to 1820, top 96, bleeds off the bottom edge; titlebar 70, tab strip 58
layout.viewport: Ask scroller 700 px tall; empty state bottom-aligned, blocks top-aligned and scrolled to keep the newest block in view
layout.composer: pinned under the scroller; hint row ends at y 1112, >= 80 px from the bottom edge
layout.menu: Choose AI dropdown opens above the composer pill, left-aligned to it

copy.placeholder: Ask about prod-replica, or type SQL
copy.gate_hint: AI-written SQL that only reads runs on its own. Writes wait for you.
copy.q1: top 5 customers by revenue this month
copy.sql1:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
copy.result_meta: 5 rows · 38 ms · Chart | Table · Open in editor
copy.hold: This statement can change data. Nothing has run yet.

beats.motion: pointer glides to the composer Choose AI pill, press; menu scales in (expo.out 0.2 s); pointer to Claude, press; menu and composer pill fade; titlebar pill crossfades to the active state
⌘ T kbd in the hint row flashes once; q1 types glyph by glyph with the auto chip; ↵ kbd flashes and send presses
empty state out, block in, tab renames; Thinking ping; answer and SQL lines reveal; Running row; card unclips to the result and bars grow (expo.out, 0.07 s stagger). Dominant beat; poster at 5.8 s
q2 types; list scrolls to the new block; Thinking; SQL reveals; hold row lands and Run it gets a soft accent halo that breathes once. Nothing runs
list fades (power2.in); titlebar pill, tab title, composer pill and empty state return; exact frame-0 state from about 9.8 s

content.ambient: one radial glow breathing on sine.inOut, yoyo over the full 10 s so it returns to its frame-0 scale

truth_deviations.chart_and_grid: The real block shows the chart or the table (a Chart | Table toggle), never both, and the chart draws vertical bars. The piece shows the chart view with the toggle and the real '5 rows' meta instead of a grid beside a horizontal chart.
truth_deviations.titlebar_pill: The titlebar renders ProviderPill whenever the app runs, so frame 0 shows Choose AI in the titlebar as well as the composer instead of an empty slot.
truth_deviations.cmd_t: ⌘T opens a new Ask tab; the piece highlights the composer's own '⌘ T new ask' hint instead of opening a second tab.
